title: Breathing Illustrates How We Should Manage Tensions | Tim Arnold
description:
https://www.speakers.ca/speakers/tim-arnold/

Book this speaker as a keynote speaker for your next event by contacting info@speakers.ca

Leaders are often in a tug-of-war, facing countless conflicting demands such as planning vs. action, competition vs. collaboration, change vs. stability, and work vs. home. In order to thrive, leaders must wrestle with these competing values and tackle crux issues head on. Tim Arnold provides his audiences with a unique framework and powerful tools to understand and succeed in mastering the complexity they face in their professional and personal lives.
